name: Code assistant, 8 concurrent, ~2k in / 1k out
description: 160 coding requests at a concurrency of 8 with long outputs. Code tokens are denser than prose and the outputs are four times longer than in the chat workload, which changes the decode/prefill balance and often the speculative-decoding acceptance rate too.
notes: Speculative decoding usually looks better here than on prose; record the acceptance rate in metrics.acceptance_rate when the engine reports it.
